img_altPresent_summary_fail: This image has no alternative text.
img_altPresent_hint_fail: Write alternative text that says what the image shows. If it is only decoration, mark it as decorative instead.
img_altPresent_summary_fail_blankAlt: This image's alternative text is only spaces, so it is neither described nor marked as decorative.
img_altPresent_hint_fail_blankAlt: Write alternative text that says what the image shows. If it is only decoration, mark it as decorative instead.
textAlternative_summary_cantTellFileName: The alternative text of this image, "{{text}}", looks like a file name.
textAlternative_hint_cantTellFileName: A file name tells someone who can't see the image nothing about it. Replace it with text that says what the image shows.
textAlternative_summary_cantTellPlacehol: The alternative text of this image, "{{text}}", is a placeholder or a generic word.
textAlternative_hint_cantTellPlaceholder: Words such as "image" or "photo" don't say what the image shows. Replace them with a short description, or mark the image as decorative if it is only decoration.
textAlternative_hint_cantTellRedundantPr: Screen readers already say it is an image. Start with what the image shows, without "Image of" or "Picture of".
textAlternative_hint_cantTellTooLong: Keep the alternative text to a sentence or two. Put longer descriptions in the text or a caption.
img_altQuality_summary_cantTell: Check that this image's alternative text describes it.
img_altQuality_hint_cantTell: Say what the image shows or why it is there, in a sentence or two, without repeating the text next to it.
img_altDecorative_summary_cantTell: This image is marked as decorative. Check that it only decorates.
img_altDecorative_hint_cantTell: If it shows information, such as a chart or a person, write alternative text that says what it shows.
pAsHeading_summary_cantTell: This short, large, bold paragraph looks like a heading.
pAsHeading_hint_cantTell: If it introduces a section, make it a heading instead of a bold paragraph, so people using screen readers can find and skip between sections.
pAsHeading_summary_cantTell_bodySize: This bold line comes before plain text, as a heading does.
pAsHeading_hint_cantTell_bodySize: If it introduces the text after it, make it a heading instead of a bold paragraph, so people using screen readers can find and skip between sections.
tdHasHeader_summary_cantTell_noHeaders: This table has no header cells.
tdHasHeader_hint_cantTell_noHeaders: If the table holds data, turn on its header row (or header column), so each cell is read with its label. A table used only to place things side by side needs no headers.
tdHasHeader_summary_fail: This table cell has no header.
tdHasHeader_hint_fail: Make the first row (or column) of the table its header, so every cell is read with its label.
linkNameQuality_summary_cantTell: The link text "{{name}}" doesn't say where it leads.
linkNameQuality_hint_cantTell: Use link text that says where the link goes, such as "Download the 2026 price list" instead of "Download" or "Click here".
linkNameQualityLinkOnly_summary_cantTell: The link text "{{name}}" only makes sense with the sentence around it.
linkNameQualityLinkOnly_hint_cantTell_in: People often move from link to link, hearing only the link text. Make the link text itself say where it goes, such as "the 2026 price list" instead of "click here".
linkNamePresent_hint_fail: Give the link text that says where it goes. For an image link, write alternative text that says where it goes.
headingOrder_summary_cantTell: This heading jumps from level {{fromLevel}} to level {{toLevel}}, skipping a level.
headingOrder_summary_cantTell_previous: The level {{toLevel}} heading "{{text}}" comes after the level {{fromLevel}} heading "{{previousText}}", skipping a level.
headingOrder_hint_cantTell: Go down one level at a time: a level 2 heading is followed by level 3, not level 4. Choose the level by the outline, not by how the heading looks.
emptyHeading_hint_fail: Write the heading's text, or remove the heading if it isn't needed.
identicalLinksSamePurpose_hint_cantTell: Links with the same text should go to the same place. If they go to different places, make each link's text say where it goes.
cmsLinkToDocument_summary_unstated: This link opens a {{format}} file, but the text doesn't say so.
cmsLinkToDocument_hint_unstated: Add the file type and size after the link text, such as "Annual report (PDF, 2 MB)". Check the file itself is accessible too.
contrastMinimum_fail_belowThreshold: This text is hard to read: its colours have a contrast of {{ratio}}:1, and it needs at least {{threshold}}:1.
contrastMinimum_hint_fail: Choose a darker text colour or a lighter background (or the other way round) in the block's colour settings, until the contrast reaches {{threshold}}:1.
